windows: Windows selected to contain strong screen excursions. Primary: guard0.3d/side0.4d; sensitivity guard0.15d/side0.3d and guard0.5d/side0.4d. QUALITY=0 with finite pixel frames; interpolate before/after images to event mean time.
test: Use existing pixel_difference routine unchanged. Outer-ring plane removal; compare positive difference centroid to Gaia WCS target; compare stationary source-shape scaling with gradient motion terms; plot all three events side by side. Hourly moments are descriptive, not precision astrometry.
weakening: An excess spatially displaced from target, background structure, or motion dependence weakens attribution to a J0754 flare even if aperture lightcurve looks convincing.
